info.title: Heist External API
info.description: Create an OAuth app in Settings → OAuth apps and send its access token in the Authorization: Bearer <token> header. Exchange the app's client ID and secret for access tokens at https://identity.heist.security/oauth2/token using the OAuth 2.0 client_credentials grant. Requests are scoped to the app's workspace and permissions.

oauth2.description: OAuth app client credentials. Authenticate to the token endpoint with HTTP Basic (client_secret_basic) or client_id and client_secret form fields (client_secret_post), then send the access token as a Bearer token.

post.description: Create a credential using an existing sign-in method. Provide its matching payload; GOOGLE needs none. BASIC supports existing username/password accounts: basic.username may be a customer-owned email address and basic.password is the account password. Heist cannot read emails sent to addresses outside tester.heisthq.com. EMAIL is for email OTP or magic-link login and requires a Heist-controlled address on tester.heisthq.com. MICROSOFT and CUSTOM use a generated Heist email. SMS and CUSTOM use an available Heist phone. Omit applicationIds to link all in-scope roots, or send [] to create unassigned. isCrossWorkspace creates a separate tenant lane; entityId joins an existing lane. New credentials are appended at the least privileged position.
